title: Ecommerce Operations & Customer Experience Manager – Full Time Role
description:
About Us:



We are a 3 year old fast-growing ecommerce brand selling aftermarket automotive styling parts across the EU and US. We sell through Shopify and run a lean, performance-driven operation. We're looking for a sharp ops manager to own our day-to-day operations and customer experience function.



The Role:



You will be responsible for running daily operations, managing our CX staff, and making sure our customer experience is fast, consistent, and professional. You will also work closely with our supplier, acting as the operational bridge between fulfilment and the customer. You will report directly to the founder and be expected to work autonomously.

This is not a task-taker role. We want someone who identifies problems, builds processes, and fixes things without being asked.



What You'll Own



- Day-to-day management of our CX staff including performance, targets, and quality

- Overseeing Slack channels, making sure nothing gets missed and escalating when necessary 

- Gorgias ticket oversight and SLA compliance

- SOP creation and maintenance for all repeatable processes

- Weekly reporting on CX metrics: refund rate, response time, resolution rate

- Refunds/Chargebacks and escalation handling

- Coordinating between CX data and product/operations decisions

- Working directly with our supplier to resolve fulfilment issues, product delays, stock discrepancies & product pricing

- Proactively managing order issues end-to-end so customers are kept informed and happy without needing founder involvement

- Using initiative to keep operations running smoothly when problems arise



Requirements:



- Minimum 2 years experience managing ecommerce operations with at least one direct report. Must be able to demonstrate measurable outcomes from previous roles.

- Must mention "cars" in reply to this job post

- Must be able to provide proof of past employment and references (non-negotiable)

- Hands-on experience with Shopify and Gorgias

- Strong written English



Nice to Have:



- Knowledge or interest of the automotive industry 

- Exposure to automotive or technical product categories

- Experience liaising with overseas suppliers or manufacturers



Hours: 



- Mon - Fri: 10AM-7PM (1 hour lunch break)

- Sat: 10AM-4PM (1 hour lunch break)



Hiring Process:



- CV and cover letter screening

- Reference check

- Short intro call

- Paid test task ($80) relevant to the role



Compensation:



- $1,400 - $1,800/month depending on experience. Long-term role with growth potential as the business scales.



To Apply:



Send your CV and a short cover letter explaining your experience managing ecommerce operations. Include the name of the store or brand you managed and your main responsibilities. Do not use AI in your response, applications who do not follow the instructions will not be considered. 

References will be contacted before interview. Do not apply if you cannot provide at least two professional references from previous employers.

title: Appointment Setter B2B — $1,000 US per month + $50 per show-up
description:
Please just send us any message if you're interested, and we will send you a Google Form. All applications will be considered through the form.

Why strong setters join us

We built a role where your results are directly reflected in what you earn — with a guaranteed base, clear performance bonuses, and a team that genuinely invests in your growth. If you're experienced, consistent, and take your craft seriously, this is a place where you can build something real.

01 — Uncapped earning potential



Your compensation grows with your performance. The structure is transparent, the targets are achievable, and there's no ceiling on what you can earn each month.

02 — Experienced leadership that develops you



You'll work closely with a team that knows this business inside and out. We share what's working, coach on what isn't, and help you sharpen your skills continuously — tone, objection handling, and conversation flow.

03 — A supportive, high-performing team



We hold a high standard here, and we support each other in reaching it. You'll be working alongside people who are serious about their work and their growth.



Compensation — paid every week via Wise

Base salary: $1,000 USD/month — guaranteed



Per qualified appointment (showed up): $50 USD — every one, on top of the base



Working hours



9:00 AM – 5:30 PM Eastern Time (ET)



That is 10:00 PM – 6:30 AM Philippine Time (PHT).

This is a night shift role. We are fully transparent about that. There is a strong and experienced community of Filipino professionals who work US hours — if that's you, and you're comfortable with it, the compensation reflects the commitment.



Onboarding



Your first 10 days are structured onboarding. We walk you through everything — the script, the CRM, and the process — until you feel fully confident.

To join the core team, the target during onboarding is a minimum of 3 qualified appointments. This is a realistic and achievable bar, and we'll be coaching you throughout to help you get there.



What you'll actually do



Make 150–200 outbound cold calls per day to businesses that may need commercial janitorial services.

Identify genuine needs and book qualified appointments for businesses ready to receive a cleaning quote.

Deliver a proven script naturally and conversationally — not mechanically.

Keep your pipeline and call logs updated accurately in our CRM each day.

Receive ongoing coaching and access to the strategies that have proven to work.





Who we're looking for



2+ years in B2B sales or outbound cold calling.

A natural, professional phone presence — you sound like a consultant, not a caller.

Ability to internalize a script and deliver it as a real conversation.

Stable setup: 80+ Mbps internet, a reliable computer, and a quality headset.

Comfortable navigating a CRM independently — logging calls, updating records, and managing your pipeline.





What you're walking into



A company with a clear system, transparent compensation, and leadership that takes your development seriously. You'll know exactly what's expected, exactly what you'll earn, and exactly how to grow. We want people who stay, improve, and build with us long term.

Ready to apply?



If this sounds like the right fit, we'd love to hear from you. Please apply with any message and we will send you a Google form to fill out.

title: AI Systems Architect / AI Automation Engineer
description:
About AirUs



AirUs is a rapidly growing UK short-term rental and property management company with ambitious plans to scale from 25 managed properties to over 150.



We are not looking to build a simple chatbot.



Our vision is to build an AI Operating System that becomes the intelligence layer of our entire business. We want AI to automate repetitive work, identify inefficiencies, challenge existing processes, provide strategic recommendations and continuously improve the business.



Ultimately, we want AI to think like an executive team, helping us become more profitable, more efficient and more scalable.



This is a long-term opportunity to build something genuinely innovative from the ground up.



The Role



We are looking for an experienced AI Systems Architect / AI Automation Engineer to work directly with our CEO to design, build and continuously improve our AI Operating System.



This is not just a coding role.



We are looking for someone who enjoys solving business problems using AI and automation.



You will help us build intelligent systems that don't just automate work but actively improve how the business operates every day.



Our Vision



We don't want AI that simply answers questions.



We want AI that:



Thinks critically.

Identifies operational bottlenecks.

Challenges inefficient processes.

Predicts problems before they happen.

Continuously suggests improvements.

Automates repetitive work.

Helps management make better decisions.

Improves profitability.

Reduces costs.

Helps us scale from 25 to 150+ managed properties without proportionally increasing headcount.



Ultimately, we want AI to become the intelligence layer of our company.



What We Want to Build



Our AI Operating System will eventually include specialist AI agents covering:



Finance & reconciliation

Operations

Guest communications

Client communications

Cleaning management

Maintenance management

Recruitment

HR & training

Listing creation

Property onboarding

Revenue management

Marketing

Compliance

Business intelligence

CEO reporting



The system should proactively identify opportunities to improve the business rather than simply responding to requests.



For example:



Instead of saying:



"Occupancy is 84%."



It should say:



"Occupancy is currently 84%, which is 6?low target. Four properties account for most of the shortfall. Reducing the minimum stay from three nights to two is projected to increase monthly NET profit by approximately £2,300."



This is the minimum level of intelligence we are aiming for.



Responsibilities

Design scalable AI architecture.

Build AI agents across multiple business functions.

Create advanced n8n workflows.

Integrate multiple systems into one AI ecosystem.

Build dashboards and executive reporting.

Build browser automations where APIs are unavailable.

Connect AI models to business data.

Continuously improve existing workflows.

Identify opportunities for automation.

Challenge existing business processes.

Recommend new AI solutions as the company grows.

Required Skills



You must have experience with most of the following:



n8n

Langdock

OpenAI APIs

Claude APIs

AI agent development

Prompt engineering

Workflow automation

REST APIs

Webhooks

Browser automation (Playwright or similar)

Python

JavaScript and/or TypeScript

PostgreSQL or similar databases

Vector databases / RAG

Git

Cloud deployment

Business process automation



Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) is a bonus.



Nice to Have



Experience integrating systems such as:



Property Management Systems

Airbnb



Stripe

QuickBooks

Google Workspace

Microsoft 365

WhatsApp Business

Ring

Minut

Canva

Social media platforms

Minimum Requirements



To be considered you must:



Have a minimum of 1 year of commercial experience building AI systems or AI automations.

Have excellent written and spoken English (minimum CEFR C1 level).

Be comfortable working independently.

Be proactive and solution-focused.

Have strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Be passionate about using AI to improve businesses rather than simply writing code.

The Type of Person We're Looking For



We want someone who:



Loves solving difficult business problems.

Thinks beyond the task they've been given.

Challenges inefficient processes.

Suggests better ways of working.

Builds scalable systems instead of quick fixes.

Enjoys learning new technologies.

Takes ownership of projects.

Is excited by building something completely new.



If you simply wait for instructions, this role probably isn't for you.



We want someone who constantly asks:



"How can we make this better?"



Important



To confirm you have carefully read this job description, please begin your application with the following code:



AirUsAI25^



Applications that do not begin with this exact code will not be considered.



Application Questions



Please answer all of the following:



Tell us about the most advanced AI automation, AI agent or AI system you have personally built.



If you joined AirUs tomorrow, what would be the first AI workflow or AI agent you would build and why?

Explain the difference between an AI chatbot and an AI agent.



Rate your experience from 1–10 with:

n8n

Langdock

OpenAI APIs

Claude APIs

Browser automation (Playwright or similar)

Python

JavaScript / TypeScript

APIs & Webhooks

Share links to your GitHub, portfolio or previous AI projects (if available).



Why Join Us?



This is not another automation job.



You'll have the opportunity to help design and build an AI Operating System from the ground up that will transform how an entire company operates.



If you're excited by solving real business problems with AI and want to build something that could become an industry-leading platform, we'd love to hear from you.

Turn around a first cut within an agreed timeframe (we'll set this per project)

You're not designing final production files. You're helping me explore directions fast so I can react, push back, and refine until something is worth making.



What the work looks like

- I'll send you a brief. Could be a rough concept like: "African symbols/West African visual language turned into wearable brooch pins." You come back with 4-6 visual directions. We go back and forth. That's the loop.

- You have a portfolio showing accessories, jewelry, or wearable product sketches

- You're comfortable working from cultural/conceptual briefs, not just aesthetic ones

- You can use Procreate, Canva, or any sketch tool and deliver clean visual concepts

- You're fast and not precious about iteration — I give real feedback and expect you to move with it

Hours: 5-10 hrs/week to start, with room to grow

Start: ASAP

title: Senior Lifestyle Manager for an AI company

title: Community Builder (for founders and CEOs)
description:
We're launching a founder-facing peer community on Circle, built around *The Breakout CEO* podcast and the Intellectual Strategies brand. This community is a professional network — not a fan club. It exists to warm potential clients, generate referrals, and surface guests, while giving members genuine peer value.



This role owns the community from the ground up: platform setup, founding member recruitment, weekly engagement, growth, health reporting, and the podcast newsletter. You'll work closely with the Marketing Operations Lead, who owns editorial direction across the broader content engine.



**This is not a role for someone who needs a lot of direction. It's a role for someone who knows how to build and sustain engagement with sophisticated professionals — and can prove it.**



ABOUT US

Intellectual Strategies is a U.S.-based fractional legal team helping innovators and scaling CEOs align legal and business strategy. Our founder, Jeff Holman, also hosts *The Breakout CEO* — a podcast featuring candid conversations with growth-stage leaders in SaaS, eCommerce, and tech.



Our audience is startup founders and scaling CEOs running businesses in the $1M–$50M+ range. We're building a professional peer community to serve that audience — and we're looking for someone to build and run it.



What You'll Own

Community

- Launch and ongoing management of the podcast-centric community on Circle

- New member onboarding and welcome experience — welcome sequence, orientation, first action prompt

- Weekly engagement calendar — discussion prompts, episode threads, member spotlights, polls, Q&As, and AMAs

- Community guidelines, culture standards, and moderation

- Founding member recruitment and VIP onboarding (starting with past podcast guests)

- Identify and cultivate power members — recognize them publicly, give them elevated roles

- Community growth and health reporting (monthly)

Podcast Newsletter

- Own the podcast newsletter end-to-end — editorial direction, writing, and consistent send schedule

- Content reflects community conversations, episode highlights, member wins, and relevant resources for startup founders and scaling CEOs

- Voice is professional, direct, and substantive — written for founders making high-stakes decisions, not a coaching or wellness audience

- Surfaces community highlights and member content to the MOL for cross-channel use

LinkedIn Podcast Page

- Monitor and respond to comments on The Breakout CEO LinkedIn page — same audience, same voice, same relationship-building instinct as the community itself

- Scope may expand over time to include The Breakout CEO LinkedIn page more broadly, including coordination on post finalization and scheduling, as the team evolves



Possible Role Expansion

- As the podcast community stabilizes, this role will assist the Marketing Ops Lead in scoping and eventually launching a law firm community and supporting community-facing elements of the Breakout CEO Awards program. Neither is a current priority.

- LinkedIn responsibilities may also grow as the team evolves, potentially including broader involvement in social content finalization and distribution for the podcast brand.



What You Won't Own (other tea
mbers handle these responsibilities)

- Law firm blog or law firm newsletter 

- Podcast production, editing, or episode publication

- GHL, 
, or marketing automation 

- Podcast guest pipeline outreach and booking



Experience with Circle is a strong advantage. Familiarity with dedicated community platforms (Slack, Skool, etc.) is acceptable if you haven't used Circle specifically.



Who We're Looking For

**Must have:**

- Demonstrated community growth — not just management, but documented member growth and engagement results

- Ability to work independently without daily direction; client testimony or portfolio evidence required

- Strong enough writing to own the podcast newsletter independently — clear, direct, and credible for a professional founder audience

- Understands community as a business function, not just a gathering place

- Can adapt voice and engagement style to startup founders and scaling CEOs



This role is inherently relationship-driven work. You genuinely enjoy facilitating other people's conversations — not just broadcasting content. You find meaning in member connections and community health, not just follower counts. You're warm, consistent, and patient. If community work feels draining rather than energizing, this isn't the right fit.

Preferred

- Experience with B2B, professional services, or founder-facing communities

- Platform experience with Circle, Slack, or other dedicated community tools

- Podcast community experience

- Familiarity with community-to-pipeline connection (how community members become clients or referrals)



**This role is not a fit if:**

- Your entire portfolio is consumer wellness, coaching, or MLM-adjacent communities with no evidence of B2B adaptation

- You frame community as "creating a safe space" rather than driving business outcomes

- You can't produce specific engagement or growth metrics from past work

- You require constant content direction from the principal



The Audience Test

Our community members are startup founders and scaling CEOs navigating pivotal 
nts in their businesses. The tone that works for a coaching community, a wellness brand, or a consumer audience will not work here. Every candidate must pass a short writing test before any interview is scheduled.



*Draft a brief three-paragraph newsletter intro for a podcast that features candid conversations with scaling CEOs navigating pivotal 
nts in their businesses. Topic: CEOs who are navigating pivotal decisions usually align with a "Breakout Arc" that includes the following stages: Building traction, something Breaks and disrupts the 
ntum, new perspectives and actions lead to a Breakout 
nt, the business achieves a new breakthrough trajectory



Use whatever tools you want, including AI. Your job is to make sure the final result sounds nothing like AI (e.g., no generic openers, no motivational filler, no hedged corporate phrasing, no bullet-pointed "key takeaways.") It should read like a sharp, specific human wrote it for our specific audience.



What we're evaluating: Does the voice fit founders making high-stakes decisions? Is it clear, direct, and earned? Or does it sound like it came from a template? The writing doesn't need to be perfect. It needs to show the right instincts and the judgment to know what "right" sounds like for this audience.



**Submit the writing test with your application. Applications without it will not be reviewed.**



To Apply



Submit the following:

1. Your writing test (see above — required)

2. A brief overview of 1–2 communities you've built or grown, with specific results (member count growth, engagement metrics, outcomes); make sure to emphasize the building, as we need to launch our community

3. Any relevant portfolio links or client testimonials



**Applications without the writing test will not be reviewed.**

---

We're looking for someone who loves content, enjoys building brands and is excited by the idea of working directly with a founder.



Our ideal person doesn't wait to be told what to do—they come with ideas, create a plan, tell us what content they need, and help bring it to life.



Our founder is incredibly busy, so we're looking for someone who can take ownership of content execution and make the entire process feel organised and effortless.



You'll become an important part of the team and have the opportunity to grow as the business grows.



---

* Develop and manage our content calendar.

* Plan weekly and monthly content.

* Come to the founder with ideas rather than waiting for direction.

* Tell us what photos, videos or information you need to execute the plan.

* Helped grow our social media presence.

title: Appointment Setter
description:
We Are Drowning in Leads. We Need Someone Who Can Save Them.



At Nested Housing, we are growing fast and we have a problem most companies would kill for. Qualified prospects are coming in and we do not have enough hands to nurture them the right way. Every unconverted lead is a person we failed to help. We are not okay with that.

We are looking for one person who is ambitious, disciplined, and ready to join a community that will push them to the extremes as a full time Appointment Setter.



Who We Are



Nested Housing is a co-hosting and short term rental company built on one non-negotiable principle: every person who interacts with us leaves better than when they arrived. Whether they become a client or not. That is the standard in how we operate every single day.

We are not just a business, we are a team of people who genuinely care about each other, our clients, and the long term vision we are building together. We invest in our people the way we invest in our business because the vision isn't just a number, but rather an impact.



Our values are simple:



- Value first, ALWAYS

- Community and team culture

- Long term growth and vision

- Integrity over everything

- Results are driven by action, not words



If those words do not light something up in you, this is not for you.



The Problem You Will Solve



Right now our closing team is waiting on qualified appointments that are not coming in fast enough. Cold leads are sitting untouched. Follow ups are being missed. Rapport is not being built. And every day that passes without someone in this role is a day we leave money, impact, and relationships on the table.

You are the solution to that problem. You are the first voice, the first impression, and the first relationship a prospect has with Nested Housing. When you do your job at the highest level, our closers close, our business scales, and our mission reaches more people.

That is the impact of this role. It is not small.



What We Need From You

We hire for the trifecta. Skill can be taught. These cannot:



Capacity: You are someone who grows constantly. You do not wait to be coached. You analyze your own conversations, identify your own gaps, build your own resources, and bring them back to the team. You have the capacity to take on more responsibility over time and you genuinely want to.



Character: You do the right thing when no one is watching. You are honest with prospects even when the truth is uncomfortable. You would never sell someone on something you do not genuinely believe will help them. Your word means something and your actions prove it.



Motivation: You are not here for a paycheck. You are here because you want to build something, prove something, and become someone. You are competitive, obsessed with improvement, and the kind of person whose work ethic shows up in every area of their life.



What the Role Actually Looks Like



- High volume outbound cold outreach across multiple channels

- Vetting, qualifying, and nurturing leads with genuine care

- Booking qualified appointments for our closing team

- Tracking all outcomes in Google Sheets and Notion pipeline

- Analyzing conversations and building team resources from what you learn

- Attending mandatory team calls, accountability sessions, and 1 on 1s

- Filling EOD and EOW reports without exception

- Showing up at 8AM and being reachable through 5PM (EST)



This is a full time role. It is your only job. We are not your side hustle and you are not ours.



This Is Not For You If:



- You are motivated purely by money with no deeper purpose

- You externalize blame when things go wrong

- You cannot take feedback or think your way is the only way

- Your actions do not match your words

- You are looking for something flexible to fit around other commitments





Where This Goes

We promote from within. Every single time.



The path is real: Setter —> Lead Setter —> Closer —> Acquisitions Manager

What we are building isn't a temporary business. It's a permanent impact that will drive you to your long term vision. The culture, the relationships, and the experiences we will both gain from this partnership will leave a lifelong impact.



Compensation is performance based and tiered. The better you perform, the more you earn. Details will be discussed during the interview process.



How to Apply

Click the link below to submit your application. Incomplete applications will not be considered.

title: SENIOR FULL-STACK DEVELOPER for EdTech SaaS (Long-Term Lead Role)
description:
We are a fast-growing education platform, a study app for Australian students with an active paying subscriber base of 400+ students. We are looking for a genuinely SENIOR Filipino developer to lead development long-term. One person who can do it all: run the existing web app, run the billing system, ship a native mobile app, and build ALL new features as we scale.



READ THIS BEFORE APPLYING:

This is a SENIOR role. Not mid-level, not a senior title from a junior shop. We mean someone who has architected and led real production systems, made technical decisions they had to live with, and shipped complex systems end to end without hand-holding. If you need specs written for you, this is not your role.



NO TEAMS OR AGENCIES. We are hiring one individual who personally writes the code and works directly with the founder. If you delegate to a team or manage rather than build, please do not apply.



HOW THE ROLE WORKS:

It starts with a paid trial at around 20 hours per week: you take handover of the codebase from the outgoing developer, fix billing issues and general app bugs across all features, and get deep into how everything works. Real work from day one, not a test project. The trial confirms your level - strong seniors move to the top of the range and to full-time quickly.



From there, hours grow with need and scale, up to 40-50 hours per week as the mobile app, AI features and B2B expansion get built. Long-term, as we scale, you lead developers hired under you.



This is for someone who wants a long-term role with us as your PRIMARY FOCUS, not something to juggle between other clients.



THE STACK:

Frontend: React with TypeScript

Backend and database: Supabase - Postgres, auth, storage, edge functions, row-level security

Payments: Stripe - subscriptions, webhooks, billing portal, full lifecycle

Mobile: React Native and Expo, EAS for builds and deployment

Real-time: Supabase Realtime and websockets for community features

AI: LLM and RAG - Claude or OpenAI, pgvector for embeddings and vector search

Video: Cloudflare Stream and hls.js

Voice and video calls: LiveKit or 
 - managed, no custom WebRTC infrastructure

: Resend

Monitoring: Sentry



WHAT YOU WILL DO:

Audit and harden the Stripe subscription and billing system - webhooks, subscription lifecycle, access control, idempotency, failed payment recovery. This is the highest-sensitivity area of the business and you must be genuinely proficient here

Work through the existing bug backlog across all features: every fix traced to root cause, tested end to end, and confirmed working before it ships. Never half-done, especially anything touching payments or access

Set up proper error monitoring so bugs are caught before students report them

title: LinkedIn Ghostwriter: Refine, Polish & Prep Posts (Drafts Provided)
description:
I am Henry, founder of Alba Talent (
), a UK-registered company. We run an automated Content Engine that generates roughly 15 raw LinkedIn post drafts a week and DMs them to me and my co-founder Scott to review. What's missing: nobody turns those drafts into publish-ready posts, and nobody manages the engagement (replies, comments) once they're live. That's the job.



THE ROLE

- Take raw AI-generated LinkedIn post drafts (delivered via 
 DM, about 15/week) and rewrite them into publish-ready copy in Henry and Scott's voice

- Prep posts for publishing: formatting, hook lines, hashtags where relevant

- Monitor and reply to comments and engagement on published posts on our behalf. Note: you will not have direct login access to Henry or Scott's personal LinkedIn accounts. You'll work from prepared copy and reported engagement, not by logging into anyone's profile. This is how we work with every outbound tool, not a reflection on you.

- Flag drafts that are weak or off-brand back to us rather than force a rewrite that doesn't fit



WHAT YOU'LL NEED

- Real, demonstrable LinkedIn ghostwriting experience, ideally for a founder or executive voice, not just brand pages

- Excellent written English with near-native command of tone, rhythm, and hook-writing for LinkedIn specifically, not blog or ad copy

- Comfortable working from someone else's raw draft and voice notes rather than starting from a blank page

- Some familiarity with B2B sales or agency content is a plus, not required



PAY: $6-9/hour to start, based on how much of this you've clearly already done. The strongest, most specific applications start at the top of that range.



HOW TO APPLY

Start with the word HERMES so I know you read the whole post. Then tell me: 1) a specific LinkedIn post you've ghostwritten for someone else that performed well, what was the hook, and what made it work, and 2) how you'd take a rough, unpolished draft (bullet points, a voice note transcript, whatever) and turn it into a finished post. Walk me through your actual process. Applications missing either get skipped.

title: Now Hiring: Real Estate Dispositions Manager
description:
Schedule: 6 hours/day, Monday-Friday, ideally overlapping with US business hours for buyer calls.



Compensation: Base pay plus 2% commission on the assignment fee for any deal you work — whether that’s pre-selling a property before it’s under contract, sending out a deal once it’s locked up, gathering buyer interest, confirming price, or closing. Deals closed independently by leadership without your involvement are not commissionable.



What you’ll do:



 • Manage relationships with our cash buyer/investor list — vetting buyers so we know who’s reliable and who might try to go around us

 • Call buyers on potential deals before we even have them under contract — “Would you buy this if I got it locked up?” — to gauge real interest and pricing before we commit

 • Send out deals once they’re under contract, field responses, and follow up with the most interested buyers

 • Present deals persuasively: pricing, numbers, and why it’s a fit

 • Build rapport quickly and close with confidence

 • Hold firm on price — buyers will try to negotiate you down, and you know how to stand your ground while keeping the relationship warm

 • Keep tabs on escrow through closing — confirm EMD is in, confirm all documents are signed, and stay on top of the file as our point person to make sure everything closes smoothly

 • Track deal flow from first buyer contact through closing

 • Follow up consistently to keep tabs on what buyers are looking for



What we’re looking for:



 • Excellent written and spoken English — you’ll be communicating directly with US-based buyers, so clarity and natural conversation matter

 • Outgoing, confident, natural people-person — someone who can build trust in the first 60 seconds of a call

 • Sales and negotiation experience — you need to be able to hold your price when buyers push back and try to squeeze the deal for less

 • Real estate transaction experience is a strong plus

 • Comfortable with rejection and persistent without being annoying

 • Coachable — you’ll be working closely with leadership on strategy and pricing



Nice to have:



 • Prior dispositions experience

 • Transaction coordinator (TC) experience — comfortable following up on paperwork, escrow, and closing timelines

 • Experience working directly with US-based clients or buyers



If you love talking to people, thrive on closing deals, and want to be part of a fast-moving investment team — apply now.



To apply: Please include a 30-second voice recording introducing yourself and why you’re a fit for this role. You can attach a voice memo or a Loom/Vocaroo link in your application

title: AI Creative & Shopify Landing Page Designer
description:
Job Description



We’re hiring a full-time AI Creative & Shopify Landing Page Designer to work across a handful of DTC brands in the fashion, fitness, and beauty niches selling in Scandinavia.



This role is for someone who is highly competent, fast, independent, and deeply fluent with AI tools. You should be able to take concepts, references, product details, brand direction, and rough ideas — then turn them into polished static ad creatives and Shopify landing pages without needing constant hand-holding.



We are not looking for a basic Canva designer or someone who only follows templates. We are looking for a sharp ecommerce creative who understands Shopify design, can build directly inside Shopify, and knows how to use AI tools daily to move faster and produce better work.



What You’ll Be Doing



You will create static ad concepts in a wide range of styles for our DTC brands. This includes AI-generated product visuals, lifestyle concepts, comparison ads, testimonial-style creatives, problem-solution graphics, product benefit visuals, and other ecommerce-focused static ads.



You will also build landing pages directly inside regular Shopify, based on concepts, references, and direction provided by us. You should be comfortable working inside the Shopify theme editor, building page sections, adjusting layouts, improving visual presentation, and solving small design or code-related issues when they come up.



This is a hands-on execution role, but you should also be able to think creatively and suggest better ways to execute a concept when needed.



Tools & Skills We Care About



You should be highly comfortable using AI tools every day, especially for image generation, prompt refinement, creative problem-solving, and Shopify troubleshooting.



Experience with the following is highly relevant:



* Higgsfield

* ChatGPT / GPT

* Claude

* Nano Banana

* Canva or another strong visual editing platform

* Shopify theme editor

* Basic Liquid/CSS troubleshooting with the help of AI

* AI prompt refinement and image-generation iteration



Higgsfield understanding is especially important. You should know how to troubleshoot AI-generated visuals, refine prompts, fix weak outputs, and keep iterating until the final result looks strong enough for ecommerce use.



Requirements



You should have at least **1–2 years of ecommerce, Shopify, design, or AI creative experience**.



You must be able to:



* Create strong static ad concepts using AI

* Build landing pages directly inside Shopify

* Work quickly without sacrificing quality

* Follow references and brand direction closely

* Use AI tools daily as part of your workflow

* Troubleshoot problems independently

* Work with copy provided by our copywriters

* Handle Scandinavian-language copy carefully, even if you do not speak the language

* Communicate clearly and directly

* Manage tasks through Notion

* Work full-time with high availability and high output expectations



You do not need to be fluent in Norwegian, Swedish, or Danish. Our copywriters handle the copy. However, you need to be careful when placing Scandinavian text into designs and landing pages.



Who This Role Is For



This role is for someone who is brutally competent, resourceful, and AI-native.



You should enjoy figuring things out. When something breaks in Shopify, you should be able to use AI, documentation, and your own judgment to solve it. When an AI image output looks bad, you should know how to refine the prompt, change the direction, or manually polish the asset until it works.



You should be comfortable being given a reference and a goal, then independently producing something usable.



Who This Role Is Not For



This is not for someone who needs step-by-step instructions for every task.



This is not for someone who only makes generic Canva templates.



This is not for someone who claims to “know AI” but cannot consistently generate high-quality visuals.



This is not for someone who only designs pages but cannot build them inside Shopify.



This is not for someone who works slowly, waits around, or gives up when a tool produces a bad result.



Work Setup



This is a full-time remote role. You can work from anywhere in the world.



Tasks will be assigned through **Notion**, and you will communicate directly with us.



Compensation is a **competitive salary based on experience, skill level, and output quality.



To Apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Examples of AI-generated static ad creatives you have made

3. Examples of Shopify landing pages or ecommerce pages you have built

4. A quick explanation of which AI tools you use most and how you use them in your workflow

5. Your availability and expected monthly salary



We care much more about output quality, speed, taste, and problem-solving ability than formal credentials.

title: Growth-Minded Mid/Senior Python Developer
description:
Do you enjoy development and stimulating work that we approach like a game, with challenges and learning, all while doing great work with teammates who care? Let’s team up.



We believe in people. This is why we only work with clients who serve people. From firefighters, to law firms, to suppliers sending life-saving food to kids dying of malnutrition, the code you write will help make the world a better place.



Our team is made up of people who want to do the best work of their life. People who love to learn, challenge themselves, grow and have some fun along the journey. We also care about each other – we support each other in our own personal goals and vision. We are human beings before employees and we love to bring out the best in each other.



Now, ready to learn more about this opening? Buckle up.



If you work here, you’ll be:

- Challenged to do the best work of your life in a supportive environment.

- Become the best communicator you can become (this is the most important thing we do).

- Have the space to ask questions, voice your feedback and make a difference (and be yourself).

- Help expand our codebase and tools, participate in code reviews, and grow with your fellow developers.



You’ll do well in this job if you:

- Have a strong background in Python and understand HTML, CSS and Javascript enough to be dangerous.

- Enjoy working with people who actually care about what they do and will not let you be lazy or do sloppy work.

- Have an opinion and care about best practices and love learning and creating and building.

- Are familiar with common things we deal with as developers: Git, SQLAlchemy, building and engaging with APIs, linters, etc.

- Have grit and determination and are someone who will exceed no matter what gets in your way.

- Are attentive to details.

- Have 3+ years of Python development experience.



You probably shouldn’t apply if:

- You’re “just looking for extra money.”

- You like working 5 full-time jobs because all you care about is work.

- You get offended easily and take things personally.

- You are not someone with grit and determination who can persevere while being challenged to do great work.

- You get overwhelmed easily with new code, new habits, new learnings and chat messages.



The interview process:

- Since 99% of our work is done via Slack (we don’t do scheduled calls), the entire interview process will be via
. (With lots of questions, sprinkled with a few voice notes)

- You may be able to speak with a developer or two on our team to see how they like the role.



If you work here:

- You’ll get 13th month salary, Filipino holidays, unlimited time off (we don’t count sick days), a normal working day schedule (no night shifts, although an early start is preferred for time overlap) with some flexibility, a week off during the holidays in December, and the opportunity to grow and become your best self.



A little more about us:

- We’ve been in business for a decade+. Our teams are remote (mostly in the Philippines). Our longest standing tea
mber has been with us for over 13+ years. We've had people quit smoking on our teams with our help, lose weight, learn a new instrument, speak a new language, and more. We all love what we do.



How to begin

- Your mission, should you choose to accept, is to send us an
 with 3 questions you have about this role. If you’re currently in a full-time role and are looking for something new, we’re open to a transition window. We actually care about your happiness.



NOTE: While we like AI, and we use it in certain circumstances, we ask that no AI be used during communication. Communication is the most important thing we do. If I don't see your natural voice from our first interaction, then you're setting an inaccurate representation of who you are and how you communicate. And when I see that change, it's going to come across as a lack of harmony in how you communicate. Also, we don't respond to candidates who don't follow instructions.

title: SEO Content Optimizer & Wix Specialist (Blog Formatting & GEO / LLM Optimization)
description:
Project-Based | Remote | [$8.00 HR RATE]



About the Role



We're looking for a detail-oriented Wix specialist to take our already-written blog content and transform it into perfectly optimized, high-performing web pages. This isn't a writing gig — the content is provided. Your job is to format, structure, and optimize it so it ranks well on Google and gets picked up correctly by AI search tools and LLMs (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, etc.).



If you love the technical side of SEO — clean header structures, keyword placement, schema, and readability — and you know your way around the Wix blog editor, this role is for you. We're building a long-term working relationship with someone reliable, communicative, and genuinely interested in staying current with how search and AI discovery are evolving.



Key Responsibilities



-Upload and format pre-written blog articles inside the Wix blogging platform

-Structure content correctly using H1, H2, and H3 tags for readability, scannability, and SEO best practices

-Apply keyword optimization based on provided guidance (target keywords, placement, density)

-Optimize page layout, formatting, and content schema for strong crawlability by Google Search

-Apply Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) techniques so content is easily parsed, understood, and cited by AI models/LLMs

-Add appropriate meta titles, meta descriptions, alt text, and internal linking where applicable

-Proofread formatting for consistency (spacing, bullet points, image placement, mobile responsiveness)

-Communicate clearly on progress, questions, and turnaround times





Required Skills & Qualifications



-Proven, hands-on experience with the Wix blogging platform (please be specific about your experience level in your application)

-Solid understanding of on-page SEO fundamentals — header hierarchy, keyword placement, meta tags, internal linking

-Working knowledge of GEO / LLM content optimization — understanding how AI search tools crawl, parse, and cite content differently from traditional search engines

-Strong attention to detail and formatting consistency

-Excellent written English comprehension (you'll be working with pre-written content and need to preserve accuracy while optimizing structure)

-Ability to follow keyword and style guidance precisely

-Reliable, self-managed, and communicative — able to give clear updates without needing constant follow-up

-Prior experience with SEO tools (Google Search Console, Ahrefs, SEMrush, Surfer SEO, etc.) is a strong plus





Security & Access



To protect the integrity of our website, applicants should know upfront:



-You will be granted Limited Access / Collaborator Permissions within our Wix account, scoped specifically to blog content and formatting.

-You will not have admin-level access, and you will not have access to billing, payments, or account settings.

-Access will be granted only after onboarding and will be limited to what's needed to complete assigned tasks.



We take this seriously and expect the same professionalism and discretion from whoever joins the team.



Technical / System Requirements



-Stable internet connection with a minimum speed of 10 Mbps (backup connection preferred)

-A reliable computer/laptop (no tablets or phones for this role)

-Updated browser (Chrome or Firefox recommended for Wix editor compatibility)

-Quiet, professional environment for occasional video calls

-Availability for at least a few hours weekly, with flexibility to scale up based on workload





How to Apply



To be considered, please send a message that includes:



-In your first sentence, tell us: how many years of hands-on experience you have with the Wix blogging platform, AND name one SEO tool you use regularly.

-A short summary of your experience with SEO formatting and/or GEO/LLM optimization.

-Any examples, portfolio links, or live blog pages you've formatted or optimized (Wix links preferred).

-Your available hours per week and preferred working hours (please note your timezone).



-Applications that skip the filtering question in step 1 will not be reviewed. We're looking for someone detail-oriented from the very first message — this is part of the screening process.



We're excited to find someone who takes pride in clean, optimized, well-structured content. If that's you, we'd love to hear from you! 



Sincerely,



-David Bates

Managing Director

title: Physician Recruiter - US Hospital Client (Oregon) - Night Shift, Remote
description:
US-based direct-hire healthcare recruiting firm is hiring a Physician Recruiter (full-cycle, voice) dedicated to a US hospital client's physician openings — employed, permanent positions (medical oncology, cardiology, anesthesiology, and more) at a coastal-Oregon community hospital. Our AI engine builds the physician lists and handles the first outreach wave; you take over the human part: get physicians on the phone and
, run a white-glove screen, collect the CV, verify licensure and board certification, write a submit-ready presentation, and coordinate interviews with our US team. Fully remote, Philippines-based, long-term.



Physician recruitment is the premium desk: fewer, bigger placements, longer cycles, and candidates who expect to be treated like the professionals they are. Your quota is measured in quality conversations, CVs collected, and screened submissions — not dial counts.



WHAT YOU DO DAILY:

- Work the AI-generated physician worklists and every inbound physician reply: phone + personal
 follow-up, evenings-their-time persistence, always professional.

- Run a structured physician screen: specialty and board certification, current practice setting, licensure states and Oregon licensure pathway, compensation expectations, relocation/timeline, motivation.

- Collect the CV, verify credentials (board certification, active state licenses, any flags) BEFORE submission — nothing unverified reaches the client.

- Write the physician presentation packet (specialty, training, certifications, availability, comp expectations, why-this-opportunity) and book the submission + interviews with our US team.

- Keep the ATS honest: every touch, every disposition, same day.



REQUIRED:

- 3+ years recruiting US PHYSICIANS specifically — at a physician-search/staffing firm OR an in-house hospital physician-recruitment office. Nurse/allied-only recruiting does not qualify for this seat (we have a separate opening for that — see our other posts).

- You know the physician-recruitment mechanics without looking them up: board certification vs board eligibility, state licensure and IMLC, employed vs locums vs private-practice models, sign-on/relocation/loan-repayment structures, and the sourcing channels physicians actually use.

- Proven personal numbers: searches worked, physicians presented, placements made, typical time-to-fill. We verify on the interview.

- Excellent spoken and written English — physicians are the most discerning candidates in healthcare; your calls and
s must be flawless and warm.

- Fixed US night shift long-term (9:00 PM-6:00 AM PHT, Mon-Fri) with a professional home setup (quiet room, headset, stable internet, backup power/data).



COMPENSATION: $1,200-$1,500/month base (by experience and proven physician placements; night differential included) + performance commission on every physician placement — specifics discussed at offer. Paid via Wise, reliable and on time.



DO NOT APPLY IF: you have never personally recruited physicians for US positions (nurse/allied/tech-only experience — apply to our Senior Recruiter post instead); you've only sourced/researched and never screened and presented a physician yourself; you can't state your own search/placement numbers; your English isn't strong enough for physician-level conversations; or you can't commit to the fixed US night shift.



WHY US: a dedicated physician desk with live, real openings on day one (not a cold start), an AI engine doing the sourcing grind for you, and commission on placements whose fees make this the highest-leverage seat in the company. Clear path: Physician Recruiter ? Physician Desk Lead.



TO APPLY, ANSWER ALL SIX (applications missing any of these will not be reviewed):

1. Describe your US physician recruiting experience: firm/hospital name(s), years, which specialties you recruited, and employed-permanent vs locums mix.

2. Your REAL personal numbers for a recent year: searches worked, physicians presented/submitted, placements closed, typical time-to-fill. (Honest ranges beat inflated exact numbers — we verify.)

3. In your own words (no lookup): what does an employed medical oncologist need in place before practicing at an Oregon hospital? (Think certification, licensure, and anything else a hospital will credential.)

4. Include a LINK to a 60-90 second voice recording: the OPENING of a call to a cardiologist about a coastal-Oregon employed opportunity — introduce yourself, respect their time, and earn the next five minutes. (The single most important part of your application.)

5. Fixed US night shift (9:00 PM-6:00 AM PHT), Mon-Fri, long-term — Yes/No + any constraint. Home setup: internet speed, headset, quiet room, backup power/internet — Y/N each.

6. Current/most-recent monthly pay (PHP or USD), expected monthly base, earliest start date.

title: Phone Support Executive Assistant/Leasing Agent (WFH)
description:
We are looking for someone who naturally enjoys talking to people, building relationships, and being the welcoming first voice of our company.



If you view work as simply clocking in and clocking out, this role will likely not be a fit.



If you take pride in ownership, genuinely enjoy helping people, and want to become an indispensable part of a growing business, keep reading.



WHO YOU ARE



-You are warm, friendly, and confident on the phone.

-You know how to make people feel comfortable within the first few moments of a conversation.

-You enjoy talking with people and helping them move forward.

-You are reliable, proactive, and take responsibility without needing constant supervision.

-You don't sound robotic, scripted, or transactional, and you usually avoid filler words such as "um."

-You understand that being the first voice someone hears can directly impact a company's success.



AVAILABILITY EXPECTATIONS



-Monday-Friday availability during business hours (U.S. Pacific Time)

-Primary phone monitoring coverage between 6:00 AM and 4:00 PM Monday-Friday (U.S. Pacific Time Zone)

-Ability to answer calls whenever reasonably available during committed working periods

-Additional responsiveness outside primary coverage hours is part of the ownership mindset required for this role



Success in this role is measured by reliability, responsiveness, caller experience, and ownership, not by sitting at a computer for a specific number of hours (and actually it's perfectly reasonable for some things like phone monitoring to be handled via your own mobile phone outside of primary availability hours).



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE (NON-NEGOTIABLE)



-Work-from-home experience

-Night shift experience

-At least 2 years with the same employer

-Executive Assistant, Customer Service, Receptionist, Sales, Hospitality, or BPO experience

-Significant phone-based experience

-Excellent spoken English with a clear and professional speaking voice (using little to no filler words)

-Enjoy using Technology and regularly check your phone

-Prior Property Management experience is not required. We are more interested in strong communication, relationship-building, and phone skills. Our successful teammate came from a sales background.



THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF:



• You dislike talking to people

• You prefer scripted conversations

• You need constant supervision

• You are looking for a role that turns into management or a different path. (We are a small company, which means you will already be handling a wide variety of responsibilities across the business.)

• You want a clock-in/clock-out environment



ABOUT US

---

The company doesn't have a talent problem. It has an ownership vacancy. You fill it.



---



Hours & The Deal



Full-time. Core hours 9am–1pm EST, every workday — flexible beyond that. Core hours are when the team overlaps, meetings run, and bottlenecks get solved live. The rest of your day, we care about output, not where or when.



Earn a shorter day. Perform at a high level and you earn a 7-hour workday. Truly dial in the systems, agents, and team — the machine runs without babysitting — and after a year you earn a 6-hour day at full pay. The better you build it, the less you grind. That's the deal.



---



The Stack — Non-Negotiable



Claude + Notion + Slack. That's the operating system. You live in all three, daily.



Claude — connected to Notion, Shopify, and our data. Audit brands, catch errors, review work, build agents that enforce the system so you're not chasing people manually. If you're not already using AI heavily, do not apply.



Notion — the single source of truth. Every card, every owner, every status. You enforce it.



Slack — where the team runs. Clear async communication, no meetings needed to make decisions.



No exceptions, no workarounds, no "I prefer my own tools."



---



What You Own



1. Projects get FINISHED. Not started, not 80% — done, shipped, live. You drive every open project to the finish line and kill or archive what shouldn't exist.



2. Notion 100% updated at all times. Every card has an owner, status, and proof of work. Nothing sits. People who won't keep it updated after coaching — you let them go. That authority is yours.



3. KPIs hit. Every team's sheet updated before Monday, unprompted. Teams hit their numbers or you have a written plan for what changes. You send Colin ONE report every Friday.



4. MWF all-hands + trainings — you run them. Agenda, training content, meeting cards completed, teams on pace. These are yours, not Colin's.



5. App infrastructure gets built. Own the roadmap for our internal apps and agents (Arena, content/ad systems, reporting agents) — drive the builders, remove blockers, ship it.



6. Errors don't sit. Sites, listings, inventory, orders — broken things are found by us, not by Colin logging in.



7. Performance decisions are yours. Improvement plans and removals happen without Colin's involvement. Ever.



How You Work



Level 5 agency: you find the problem, fix it, and keep Colin in the loop. Never bring a problem without a recommendation. Bottleneck? Huddle, solve it live, move on. Data d
 everything — Notion activity, KPI output, deliverables. Numbers, not vibes.



KPIs — Weekly



- Zero stale Notion cards at Friday close

- 100% of team KPI sheets in before Monday, unprompted

- MWF all-hands + trainings run, on time, every week

- Friday GM report delivered, every week

- Errors found by Colin: zero

- Projects finished vs. sitting — measured and reported



Who Fits / Who Doesn't



Fits: You've run teams. You're comfortable being the bad guy when standards slip — including letting people go. Fast, direct, organized to a fault, already AI-heavy.



Doesn't: Anyone who needs Colin to make the calls, reports problems instead of fixing them, or lets things slide to avoid confrontation. That's the exact gap this role closes.



---



Success in 90 Days



Colin opens Notion — everything's updated. Projects are finishing, not sitting. All-hands run without him. He gets one clean report Friday and hasn't repeated a memo, chased a card, or found a broken listing in a month. The team knows who runs day-to-day. It isn't him.

title: Part-Time Virtual Assistant — Content, Marketing & CRM Operations
description:
GP Hospitality Partners | Part-Time Marketing VA





JOB TITLE: Part-Time Virtual Assistant — Content, Marketing & CRM Operations



HOURS: 8-10 hours per week to start — with opportunity to grow



RATE: Competitive and commensurate with experience — discussed during the interview process



GROWTH: This role has real upside. As the business grows and you prove yourself, hours increase and compensation follows. We are not looking for someone to fill a slot. We are looking for someone who wants to grow with us long term.



SCHEDULE: Flexible — you own your schedule. Work when you work best. The process owns the sequence, not the clock.



START: As soon as the right person is found





Who We Are



GP Hospitality Partners is a leadership coaching and consulting business for independent restaurant operators across the United States. Our founder Greg Provance is the author of Loyal AF and Butts in Seats, and co-host of a weekly podcast called the Ride or Die Restaurant Show.



We run a paid membership community (the Ride or Die Leadership Circle), a weekly podcast, an online course, and an active speaking and consulting practice. Our content is direct, unapologetic, and designed to shake restaurant operators loose and make them think. No vanilla. No corporate tone. Real talk, always respectful.



This is a long-term role. We are not looking for someone to do a one-off project. We want someone who learns the operation, follows a detailed playbook, and becomes a reliable part of the team.





What You Will Do



Your work breaks into four recurring blocks each week plus a daily commenting task.



Block 1 — Content Production (~2 hours)

Greg records a podcast episode every Monday. Within 48 hours you pull the transcript and video clips from Riverside, run them through Claude (AI tool — prompts provided) to generate seven content assets, load everything into GoHighLevel for Greg's review, and notify him the batch is ready. Content releases two Tuesdays after recording — you have a built-in buffer.



Block 2 — Post-Approval Execution (~1.5 hours)

After Greg approves inside GHL, you paste show notes into Riverside, schedule the website blog article, and lock all social posts for the Tuesday release. LinkedIn articles schedule via LinkedIn's native scheduler on Wednesdays.
 and Instagram posts (including video clips) go through GHL.



Block 3 — CRM and Pipeline Admin (~2 hours)

You harvest new LinkedIn connections from Dripify daily and load them into GHL — tagged by role (owner vs. operations manager), segmented, and enrolled in the right
 nurture sequence. You run weekly CRM audits, handle LinkedIn Sales Navigator prospecting, draft and post daily 
ments for follower growth, and send Greg a weekly CRM summary every Monday.



Block 4 — Research and Outreach (~2-3 hours)

You manage the podcast guest pipeline — sourcing guests, drafting outreach for Greg's approval, coordinating confirmed guests. You research shows where Greg should be a guest (restaurant and cross-industry). You track speaking and trade show opportunities. Monthly, you produce submission-ready trade publication articles adapted from the best episode of the month.





Tools You Will Use



You will receive login access to all of these:





GoHighLevel (GHL) — social calendar,
, CRM, contact management, and content approval workflow; as you grow into the role, you will also help build
 sequences, automation workflows, and campaign infrastructure

LinkedIn and LinkedIn Sales Navigator — scheduling, DM monitoring, prospecting

Riverside — podcast platform, transcript and video clip downloads

Dripify — LinkedIn automation; you will start with contact harvesting and campaign monitoring, and grow into building and managing campaigns over time

Google Drive — shared content folder for all drafts and assets

Claude (claude.ai) — AI drafting tool (free account, prompts provided)





Day one: You are executing a proven playbook. Following processes, producing content, managing contacts, doing research.

Over time: As you prove yourself, you take on more — building GHL workflows, managing Dripify campaigns, owning more of the technical infrastructure.



We will train you on everything. What matters on day one is that you are organized, reliable, and not intimidated by new platforms.





What We Are Looking For



Required — these are non-negotiable:





Strong written English — you review AI-generated content and must catch errors before it goes to Greg

Reliable and self-directed — you work independently, manage your own time, and send updates before being asked

Organized — clean folder structures, consistent naming, nothing slipping through

Comfortable learning new software — you figure things out, you ask smart questions, you don't guess and break things

Responsive — replies to messages same day during your working sessions

Available 8-10 hours per week on a consistent basis





Preferred — these make you a stronger candidate but are not required:





Any experience with GoHighLevel — even basic contact management or
 sending

Any experience with Dripify or LinkedIn automation tools

Background in social media scheduling, content management, or CRM work

Experience supporting US-based entrepreneurs, coaches, or consultants





A note on the technical skills: We are not hiring a GHL developer or a marketing automation specialist on day one. We are hiring someone sharp, organized, and self-directed who will grow into the technical side of this role over time. If you have never heard of GoHighLevel, that is fine. If you are the kind of person who figures out new tools quickly and takes pride in building things that work — that is what we need.



We will train the right person. What we cannot train is reliability, initiative, and the ability to think independently under pressure. Those you either have or you don't.





What This Role Is Not



You are not a copywriter or creative strategist. AI tools handle drafting — prompts are provided. Your job is to run the process precisely and execute with accuracy. You are not a salesperson. You never pitch Greg's services to anyone. You flag warm leads and Greg handles them. You do not make decisions about what gets published, sent, or submitted. Everything goes to Greg for approval first.





What Good Looks Like in This Role





Content batch is loaded into GHL and Greg is notified within 48 hours of Monday recording

Greg never has to ask where something stands — you send the update first

All GHL contacts are tagged correctly and enrolled in the right sequence

Daily 
ments are drafted and ready for Greg's review every day

Nothing goes live without approval

When something is unclear, you ask before you guess







How to Apply



Send a message that includes:





Start your message with the word OPERATOR. This tells us you read the posting carefully — a required trait for this role. Applications that do not start with OPERATOR will not be reviewed.

A brief intro — who you are, where you're based, and how long you've been doing remote work.

One paragraph describing a time you managed a recurring process or kept a system organized for someone else. What was the task, how did you handle it, what happened?

Your general availability — which days of the week you typically work (Philippine Standard Time).

Test Task One — Voice and Format:

Below is a short excerpt from a podcast transcript. Write a 
ment (not a post — a comment, 3-4 sentences max) responding to this content as if it appeared on a high-profile restaurant industry account's post. The comment should add a specific insight, sound like a real operator talking — not a consultant, not an AI. No em dashes. No corporate language. No "great post." Make the reader want to click the profile of whoever wrote it.







TEST TASK ONE — TRANSCRIPT EXCERPT:



"The thing I see most often with restaurant operators is that they're stuck on the floor. They built a team, they hired managers, but they're still the one solving every problem. A guest complaint comes in — they handle it. A call-out happens — they cover it. The manager is there but the owner is doing the manager's job. And the reason that happens almost every time is that nobody ever taught the manager how to actually lead. They got promoted because they were a good server or a good cook. But being good at your job and being good at leading people are two completely different skills."







Test Task Two — Prioritization and Independent Thinking:

No prompts. No format instructions. Just a scenario.





It is Tuesday morning. Greg recorded the podcast episode yesterday but the transcript is not ready in Riverside yet. You have the following on your plate this week:





5 
ments to draft for Greg's approval and posting

A confirmed podcast guest who has not yet replied to the logistics
 you sent last week — they record Thursday

15 new contacts in GHL with no tags and no sequence enrollment

A trade publication article due to Greg by Friday for his review

Block 1 content production waiting on the transcript that hasn't arrived yet





Walk us through exactly how you handle this week. What do you do first, what do you do next, and why. What do you communicate to Greg and when. What waits and what doesn't.



There is no right answer. We are not looking for perfection. We are looking for how you think under pressure, whether you know what's time-sensitive, whether you communicate proactively, and whether you can sequence work without being told. A candidate who spots the Thursday recording risk without us pointing it out is someone we want to talk to.





We review applications on a rolling basis and will respond to qualified applicants within 3-5 business days.





GP Hospitality Partners LLC

title: AI Video Editor (UGC & Paid Ads)
description:
**HIRING: AI UGC Video Editor / Full-Time, Remote (Base + Performance Pay)**



We are a performance-driven media company that tests and scales offers across multiple niches / supplements, ebooks, physical products, and more. We move fast, we test constantly, and every month can look different.



We are not looking for a freelancer. We are looking for a growth partner — someone who earns more when their ads perform. If you know how to build AI video ads that actually convert, this structure can make you serious money.



---



**COMPENSATION (Base + Performance Pay)**



Base salary: $400–$500/month (USD, paid monthly)

Performance bonus: 5% of net profit on every winning ad you produce



**The math — why this is worth your attention:**



We scale winners aggressively. When an ad hits, we pour budget into it.



-> Your ad generates $5,000 net profit in a month = $250 bonus. From one video.

-> Your ad generates $10,000 net profit = $500 bonus. From one video.

-> You have 3 winning ads running simultaneously = do the math yourself.



The more your ads perform, the more you earn. There is no cap.



All tools, credits, and subscriptions are fully covered — nothing comes out of your pocket.



---



**WHAT YOU WILL DO**



- Edit and produce AI UGC video ads from scripts and briefs we provide

- Work across multiple niches — one week supplements, next week ebooks or something else entirely

- Produce 5–10 video concepts per week (under 2 minutes each)

- Work across formats: talking heads, podcast-style, animations, claymation, green screen UGC

- Iterate on winners based on ad performance data

- Stay on top of new AI tools and bring fresh ideas to the team



---



**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**



- 1+ year of experience creating AI video content for paid ads

- Fluent with tools like Kling, Veo, Seedance, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, Midjourney, or similar

- You understand direct response: hooks, pacing, retention, and what actually drives conversions

- You adapt quickly — new niche, new brief, new format, no problem

- Portfolio of ads that have actually run as paid traffic (showreels do not count)

- Reliable internet, stable setup, available Monday to Friday

- Fast on revisions and zero hand-holding needed



---



**GROWTH & BENEFITS**



- Internal training program — we invest in your skills from day one

- All tools, courses, and subscriptions covered by us

- Clear growth path: Editor -> Senior Editor -> Head of Creative

- You will work across many niches and formats, making you a stronger editor than most

- Long-term position with real upside for high performers



---



**NO EXPERIENCE? READ THIS.**



Not there yet but hungry to get there?



We offer a structured training track for candidates who do not have a portfolio yet but are serious about building one. You will go through our internal training program, learn the tools, and work on real briefs — unpaid, at your own pace.



This is not for everyone. It requires real commitment and a willingness to put in the work before you get paid. But if you complete the track and prove yourself, you move straight into the paid role.



If you are the kind of person who would rather invest time to build a real skill than look for easy money — this path is for you.



To apply for the training track, include the word HUNGRY in your message and tell us in 3–5 sentences why you are serious about this.



---



**HOW TO APPLY**



Send a message with:



1. Experienced editor: start your message with the word CONVERT

2. Applying for the training track: start your message with the word HUNGRY

3. Your portfolio or a short explanation of where you are right now

4. The 3 AI tools you use most and why

5. 2–3 sentences on why you are the right fit



No effort in your application, no reply. Strong applicants hear back within 48 hours.



Let's build.

title: CONTROLLER FOR US FRACTIONAL CFO FIRM (FULL TIME, MULTI-ENTITY, PE-BACKED CLIENTS)
description:
Stack Growth Solutions is a US fractional CFO firm serving private equity and private credit backed companies. We build finance functions for multi-entity businesses from scratch: monthly close, consolidation, budgeting, lender reporting, and the systems behind them. We are hiring a full time Controller to run engagements for client books directly, while working with the firm's owner.



10-25 hrs / week to start. Full time within 6 months. 



This is not an easy role and the pay rate reflects that. We want someone who has the past experience of successfully completing tough challenges in similar roles. Our clients are growing companies with stale or missing finance infrastructure. You will work with owner to redesign and build the close process, the budget, and the accounting systems. You will then take the lead in running those functions day to day. You will work closely with firm leadership and client leadership on system design, business operations, and workflow, but you are expected to drive the build, spot what is broken, and propose the fix without being asked. You must also be a strong communicator as you will be discussing strategic plans with the CFO firm owner and clients directly.



You will own:

- Designing and standing up accounting systems, processes, and controls from scratch for multi-entity groups

- The monthly close calendar for a nine-entity roll-up, from checklist through reviewed financials

- Full-cycle accounting oversight: billing, receivables, payables, payroll review, work in progress, accruals, intercompany, cutoff

- Review of client bookkeepers' work against a defined standard

- Book cleanup and chart of accounts standardization to audit-ready quality

- Building annual budgets and supporting forecasting in FP&A software (Fathom, Jirav, or similar)

- Lender reporting preparation and consolidation support (QuickBooks and Intuit Enterprise Suite, Fathom)

- Streamlining accounting and operational workflows, and documenting SOPs as you build, in our templates



The bar:

- 5+ years in accounting with full-cycle ownership: you have personally owned everything from billing and AR/AP through close and reporting, not one slice of it

- At least 2 years owning a monthly close end to end

- You have built accounting processes or systems from scratch at least once: new entity, new ERP, post-acquisition cleanup, or a company that had nothing

- Multi-entity and intercompany experience required; roll-up, PE-backed, construction or field services (WIP, job costing), or public accounting background strongly preferred

- Budget buildout experience required; Fathom or Jirav exposure strongly preferred

- US GAAP fluency; QuickBooks Online expert; strong with technology generally and quick to learn new tools

- Written English clean enough to go to a US CEO without editing

- At least 6 hours of daily overlap with US Eastern time



How we work: everything is reviewed, everything is documented, and our deadlines are lender deadlines. Numbers that are close are wrong. If your work regularly needs a second pass, or you wait to be told what to build, this is not the right seat.



Process: application, one interview, paid test assignment on a real close scenario. Begin your application with the word LEDGER so we know you read this.



To apply, answer the following in your cover letter. Answers without specifics will not be considered.

- In your most recent close role: how many entities, how many business days to close, and what single item most often delayed it? What did you change to fix it?

- Describe a time you built an accounting process or system from scratch: what existed before, what you built, what tools you used, and how long it took to run reliably without you touching it.

- Describe an intercompany or multi-entity mess you personally untangled: the cause, how you found it, the fix, and what you put in place so it never came back.

- What share of your work has been reviewing others' work versus preparing your own? Describe a material error you caught in review that the preparer insisted was correct.

- In five sentences or fewer, explain to a non-financial CEO why his June financials changed after he already reviewed them. Write it as if you were sending it.

- Your expected monthly salary for full time work, and your working hours in US Eastern time.
