title: Senior Technical SEO & AI Search Engineer
description:
Senior Technical SEO & AI Search Engineer



Structured Data, On-Page SEO & Generative Search



**Type of work:** Full-time, remote

**Hours:** 40 hours per week

**Schedule:** Must overlap with our U.S. Central Time team for at least four business hours each weekday.

**Long-term role:** Yes



MF Digital is a U.S.-based digital marketing firm serving graduate and professional education programs, especially law, engineering, and business schools.



We are hiring a senior technical SEO and AI Search engineer to become the execution owner for high-stakes website optimization work across university program pages.



This is not a general SEO assistant, content-writing, backlink-building, social-media, or virtual-assistant role.



You will turn SEO and AI-search strategy into accurate, implementation-ready work: page specifications, schema markup, technical tickets, CMS deployment guidance, and live-site QA. You will work closely with our U.S.-based strategy, content, analytics, and operations teams. This role is not client-facing.



## What You Will Own



### 1. On-Page SEO and AI Search Specifications



You will create detailed, page-level optimization documents for graduate-program websites.



This includes:



* Keyword and search-intent analysis for individual degree pages

* Competitive page teardown and gap analysis

* Title tags, meta descriptions, H1s, H2s, and page hierarchy

* Recommendations for answer-first content blocks, FAQs, comparison content, tuition/value sections, outcomes, faculty authority, and admissions information

* Internal-linking recommendations that strengthen program-level authority

* Calls-to-action and conversion-path recommendations for organic visitors

* Fact-checking requirements for rankings, tuition, credits, outcomes, certification claims, deadlines, and career data

* Clear implementation instructions that a university web team can follow without guessing



Your work must preserve approved university information, identify missing proof points, and never introduce unsupported claims.



### 2. Advanced Schema Markup and Entity Architecture



You will design, write, validate, and maintain structured data for degree-program pages.



This includes:



* JSON-LD using clean, reusable 
 architecture

* Entity relationships across university, school, department, program, credential, course, faculty, outcomes, costs, and actions

* Appropriate use of 
 types such as:



  * `CollegeOrUniversity`

  * `EducationalOrganization`

  * `EducationalOccupationalProgram`

  * `Course`

  * `Offer`

  * `WebPage`

  * `BreadcrumbList`

  * `Article`

  * `Person`

  * `Organization`

  * `FAQPage` only when appropriate and visibly supported on-page

* Consistent entity IDs and relationships across multiple program pages

* Schema updates whenever tuition, curriculum, application links, webinar links, start dates, or program details change

* Validation through Google Rich Results Test, 
 Validator, source-code review, and rendered-page QA

* Clear deployment instructions for Drupal, WordPress, custom CMS environments, HTML templates, or tag-management systems



We do not want copied boilerplate schema. We need someone who understands why each entity, property, relationship, and field belongs on a page.



### 3. Technical SEO and Site Health



You will identify and translate technical problems into prioritized, solvable work.



This includes:



* Crawlability, indexability, canonicalization, redirects, sitemaps, robots directives, page hierarchy, duplicate content, and JavaScript-rendering issues

* Core Web Vitals, page-speed, mobile performance, and technical performance recommendations

* Google Search Console review and issue prioritization

* Recommendations for HTML structure, accessible semantic markup, structured content, and PDFs or other assets that interfere with discoverability

* Technical tickets that separate what MF Digital can execute, what the client web team must execute, and what requires outside development support



You do not need to personally control every university CMS. You must be able to diagnose the issue, write an implementation-ready solution, validate the work after deployment, and flag when a developer is required.



### 4. AI Search Readiness



You will help make university content easier for generative-search systems to understand, retrieve, and cite.



This includes:



* Structuring pages around clear entities, direct answers, sourceable facts, and machine-readable relationships

* Identifying content gaps that prevent a program from answering high-intent student questions

* Translating search intent into citation-ready page modules without making ranking or citation promises

* Supporting prompt-coverage and AI-search evidence when requested by the strategy team

* Keeping recommendations grounded in what is published, verifiable, and approved by the institution



### 5. Quality Assurance, Documentation, and Handoff



A major purpose of this role is to make MF Digital less dependent on any one outside specialist.



You will:



* Maintain organized source files, version history, schema libraries, page templates, validation records, and implementation notes

* Create reusable SOPs for program-page audits, structured data, deployment, and QA

* Document every material recommendation, source, decision, and change

* Review live implementations for broken JSON, duplicate schema, stale facts, invalid URLs, mismatched metadata, and missing content

* Make your work understandable enough that another qualified technical professional could continue it



## Required Experience



* At least 5 years of hands-on technical SEO experience

* Demonstrated expertise writing and implementing JSON-LD / 
 markup

* Proven ability to create page-level on-page SEO recommendations, not just audit summaries

* Strong HTML and CSS skills; JavaScript experience strongly preferred

* Experience working in WordPress, Drupal, custom CMS environments, or website templates

* Experience with Google Search Console, GA4, Screaming Frog or Sitebulb, PageSpeed Insights, and structured-data validators

* Strong understanding of crawl/indexing issues, technical SEO, canonicalization, rendering, redirects, sitemaps, and Core Web Vitals

* Ability to read source code, identify implementation problems, and give exact corrective instructions

* Excellent written English and unusually high attention to factual accuracy

* Experience working with large, multi-page, high-authority websites

* Comfortable working from detailed briefs, handling version control, and documenting technical decisions



## Preferred Experience



* Technical SEO work for higher education, professional services, healthcare, finance, law, or another regulated category

* Knowledge graphs, entity modeling, semantic SEO, or knowledge-panel optimization

* Python, JavaScript, SQL, or automation experience

* Experience creating reusable schema-generation workflows

* Experience with enterprise CMS or university web-governance environments

* Familiarity with how Google AI Mode, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and other generative-search systems retrieve and summarize web content



## What Success Looks Like in Your First 90 Days



* Validate and document our existing program-page schema work

* Review and improve our current on-page SEO and AI-search recommendation format

* Build a reusable structured-data architecture for graduate-program pages

* Create a technical SEO QA checklist for live deployments

* Establish clear documentation so technical work is no longer held only in one consultant’s head

* Produce implementation-ready work that our internal team and university web teams can use immediately



## How to Apply



Please include all of the following:



1. Your desired monthly full-time compensation.

2. Your available working hours and overlap with U.S. Central Time.

3. At least two live URLs where you personally created or implemented JSON-LD/schema markup.

4. For each example, explain:



   * What schema types you used

   * Why you used them

   * Whether you deployed the code yourself

   * How you validated the final implementation

mbers' dream boards.

Key Competencies

Proactive and Organized: You stay ahead of deadlines and manage many accounts without letting anything slip.

Results-Driven: You are comfortable with data and use it to guide decisions and prove value.

Consultative Seller: You spot opportunities to help clients do more and can recommend them naturally, without being pushy.

Ownership Mindset: You treat each client's business as if it were your own and follow through on your promises.

This Role Is Not for You If

You want to hide behind

title: E-commerce/DTC Video Editor - For Ads (Full Time)
description:
Performance-focused · AI-augmented · Long-term



We run paid media at scale for DTC and e-commerce brands across European markets — and we're looking for an editor who gets the why behind every cut, not just the how.



This isn't a role for someone who waits for a brief and assembles clips. We need someone who can watch raw footage and know instinctively which B-roll makes the hook land — who understands that the wrong cutaway kills a conversion and the right one doubles watch time. If you've ever paused an ad you liked just to reverse-engineer why it worked, keep reading.



The basics





Type: Full-time

Location: Remote

Compensation: 900–1,100 USD/month

Start: ASAP

Output: 3–4 finished edits per day





What you'll own





Edit short-form ad creative for Meta and TikTok — fast, punchy, conversion-oriented

Choose and sequence B-roll with intent — every clip serves the hook, reinforces the claim, or deepens the emotional pull

Build visual hooks that stop the scroll — you know the first 1–2 seconds are the entire game

Cut UGC, founder, and testimonial footage into structured formats (Hook ? Problem ? Mechanism ? CTA)

Generate AI video assets in Higgsfield and similar tools — realistic, on-brand footage that blends seamlessly with real clips

Produce modular assets that repurpose cleanly across placements and audiences





Non-negotiables



Proven DTC/e-commerce ad editing. You've edited ads that actually ran on Meta or TikTok for real brands. You understand pacing curves, attention drop-off, and how to build an edit around a conversion goal — not just aesthetics.



Intentional B-roll selection. You don't fill gaps, you amplify the script. You know when a reaction shot beats a product shot, and when on-screen text does more work than either.



Visual hook creation. You think visually first. You can concept and execute an opening that creates immediate pattern interruption — without leaning on the script to carry it.



Higgsfield + AI fluency. You're already comfortable prompting and generating realistic AI video, and you know how to make Higgsfield output that doesn't read as AI. We provide advanced internal training — but you need a real foundation to build on.



Strong English comprehension. Most scripts and voiceovers are in English. You need to catch nuance, not just words, so your edit rhythm matches what's being said and why.



Comfortable in Notion. We run briefs, trackers, and feedback through Notion. You don't need to be a power user, but you need to work inside it day to day without friction.



Nice to have





VSL or long-form ad formats for cold traffic

Direct response frameworks (AIDA, PAS, and similar)

Other AI video tools beyond Higgsfield (Kling, Runway, Pika)

Working knowledge of Meta ad structure — formats, ratios, placements





Who fits here





You think like a marketer, not just a creative — you care about what converts

You bring ideas and push back on a brief when you see a better angle

You ship final-ready work, not "almost there"

Fast iteration energizes you; it doesn't slow you down

You're driven and you work hard — you take pride in output and don't need to be chased

You want to be part of a team, not a solo freelancer — you communicate, share wins, and lift the people around you

You're honest and loyal — we'd rather hear the hard truth early than a polished excuse late, and we build long-term with people who do the same





What we offer

title: Video Editor Brand + Cinematic Post-Production
description:
We don't shoot real estate. We shoot the feeling of a place.

LEKKER Studios is a luxury real estate media company built on editorial taste, technical discipline, and a deep belief that light tells the truth about a space. We serve builders, developers, and top-tier listing agents across the NYC metro market. Our work looks like it belongs in a magazine. It sells properties and builds reputations.

We're looking for a video editor who operates at that same level. Someone who understands brand, pacing, and the difference between a cut that lands and one that doesn't. Someone who knows DaVinci Resolve not as a tool but as a language.

If you need to be told what cinematic means, this isn't the role for you. If you already know, keep reading.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Edit luxury real estate walkthrough videos, cinematic listing films, and branded short-form reels

Color grade footage to match LEKKER Studios' editorial visual identity: rich, restrained, real

Cut vertical Reels and Stories optimized for Instagram and TikTok without compromising visual quality

Build and maintain branded motion graphics templates, lower thirds, and title sequences

Sync music with intent. Pacing is editorial, not automated

Work within established brand guidelines while bringing creative ideas to every project

Collaborate directly with the founder on high-profile property films and client deliverables

Manage project files, proxies, and delivery outputs with clean, organized discipline





WHAT YOU NEED



Expert-level DaVinci Resolve. Not proficient. Expert. Color, Fusion, Fairlight, Cut page, all of it

A portfolio that shows real range: narrative pacing, color work, motion design, and brand consistency

Strong understanding of luxury brand language visually and tonally

Experience editing real estate, architecture, hospitality, or lifestyle content

Ability to work with log footage, mixed color profiles, and multi-cam timelines

Clean file management habits. Organized project structure is not optional

Reliable internet, capable hardware, and a professional home edit setup

Strong communication. You can take feedback without ego and give feedback with clarity





WHAT SETS YOU APART



You've worked on short films, brand campaigns, or editorial-grade content, not just listing videos

You understand light. You know when footage is underexposed vs atmospherically dark. The difference matters

You can watch a rough cut and feel what it needs before anyone says a word

You have an opinion. You bring ideas. You push back when something isn't right

You've built motion graphics from scratch, not just dropped in templates

You know what good audio design does to a real estate film





THE WORK ENVIRONMENT

Remote. Async-first. Direct communication with the founder. No corporate layers. No committees. Fast feedback, high standards, and real creative latitude when you've earned the trust.

This starts as a project-based engagement. For the right person it grows into a core team role. We are building something with a long shelf life and we want people who want to build it with us.



COMPENSATION

Project-based or retainer, depending on volume and fit. Rates are competitive and reflect the quality of the work we expect. We don't lowball creatives. We also don't hire people who don't value their own work.

Rate discussion happens after we see your portfolio.



HOW TO APPLY

Send the following to 
 with the subject line: Video Editor — [Your Name]

Two to three sentences on why LEKKER Studios specifically, not just "I love real estate video"

Your DaVinci Resolve experience in plain terms. What you've done, not what you know how to do

Your availability and location



We read every application. We respond to the ones that show us you actually looked at our work.

description:

LEKKER Studios is a luxury real estate media company serving the NYC metro area. We work with builders, architects, brokers, and developers who compete at the top of the market. Our photography, video, and content do not look like anyone else's. That is not an a
. It is a discipline.

We are not a volume shop. We do not post for the algorithm. We build brands.



The Role

We are looking for a Creative Director who owns social media the way a brand manager owns a product line. You will manage content for LEKKER Studios and for a portfolio of our clients across Instagram, TikTok,
, and LinkedIn.

You understand that a grid is not a gallery. It is a brand statement. Every post, every caption, every reel either builds the brand or chips away at it. You know which is which before you publish.

This role is not for someone who needs direction on every decision. It is for someone who internalizes a brand deeply enough to make the right call independently, consistently, and without being reminded.



What You Will Do

For LEKKER Studios



Own the full creative direction and content strategy across all platforms

Maintain brand voice, visual consistency, and editorial standards in every post

Build and execute monthly content calendars aligned with business goals

Collaborate with the founder on campaign direction and key brand 
nts

Track performance and bring real strategic observations, not just numbers



For Our Clients



Manage 3 to 8 active client accounts at any given time

Build individual content strategies per client based on their brand identity and market position

Post daily across Instagram, TikTok, and
 with platform-appropriate content

Edit short-form video and reels from provided photo and video assets

Handle client approvals proactively. Nothing ships late. Nothing goes out wrong.





What Brand Fluency Means Here

You can look at a brand and know what it stands for before reading the bio.

You understand that a $3.5M listing in Alpine and a spec build in Ridgewood do not get the same energy, the same caption structure, or the same posting rhythm. You feel that difference without being briefed on it every time.

You know that consistency is trust. An inconsistent grid erodes brand equity quietly. You protect it.

You understand that your aesthetic does not override the client's identity. You serve the brand. Your job is to make them more themselves. Not more like whatever is trending this week.

You write captions that sound like a human being with taste and intention. Not like a prompt. Not like a template. Not like every other luxury real estate account in the tri-state area.

You know the difference between growing followers and building the right audience. You optimize for the second one.



What We Require



Demonstrated experience managing social media for multiple brands simultaneously

A portfolio that shows real creative range across different brand voices and markets

Real estate, architecture, design, or luxury lifestyle content experience strongly preferred

Strong short-form video editing skills. CapCut, Premiere, or equivalent.

Platform fluency on Instagram Reels, TikTok, and

Content scheduling experience with tools like Later, Buffer, or Planoly

Writing ability that holds up across brand voices without sounding generated

The ability to read analytics and turn them into strategic decisions, not just reports



You will be asked in the interview to analyze a brand cold and tell us what it communicates. This is not optional. It is the job.



How You Operate

You are proactive. You surface issues before they become problems. You bring ideas without being asked. You communicate clearly and briefly. You ask smart questions early and execute without hand-holding after that.

You are told something once.

You take ownership of your accounts the way a founder takes ownership of their business. Not because someone is watching. Because the standard matters to you personally.



Compensation

Competitive and commensurate with experience and portfolio quality. Growth in responsibility and compensation is real for people who perform.

title: Customer Experience & Chargeback Manager
description:
We're a fast-growing DTC wellness brand selling to customers 50+ across the US and Canada. We're hiring one person to lead our customer service team and own the whole post-purchase experience, with a simple mandate: keep customers happy and stop chargebacks before they start.



Please read this full description before applying. We're only looking for someone highly experienced in this exact work, so if that's not you, this role isn't the right fit.



What you'll do



- Manage the customer service team day to day, review their conversations, and coach them toward faster, warmer, more accurate replies

- Optimize how we do support: the tools we use, our macros and canned responses, escalation rules and refund flows

- Audit real customer conversations to spot weak replies, recurring questions and gaps, then fix them at the source

- Defuse frustrated customers before they turn into disputes, and set the standard for how the team does the same

- Prevent chargebacks by tightening service quality and catching at-risk orders early

- Monitor shipping times, flag delays, and communicate with suppliers to resolve problem orders before the customer complains

- Keep customers informed proactively on delays, tracking and back-orders so they never feel left in the dark

- Manage and fight chargebacks across Shopify and our processors, then trace each one to its root cause and fix it

- Improve our help docs, FAQ, shipping and refund policies so fewer tickets happen in the first place

- Track and report the numbers that matter: response time, resolution rate, refund rate, chargeback rate and win rate



What you need

- Proven experience leading customer service for a Shopify DTC brand, and you know the Shopify admin cold

- Hands-on chargeback and dispute experience: fraud vs service disputes, what evidence wins, how representment works

- A track record of lowering refund or chargeback rates through better service and systems

- Experience managing and coaching a support team, not just handling tickets yourself

- Native-level, warm written English for an older audience

- Comfort in helpdesk tools like Gorgias, Zendesk, or Gmail-based inboxes

- Strong judgment on when to refund, replace or hold firm



Nice to have

- Wellness or 50+ audience experience

- Experience coordinating with suppliers and fulfillment partners on shipping issues 

- Chargeflow or similar



Success looks like

- Low chargeback rate and high win rate on the disputes we fight

- Falling refund rate as service quality rises

- A support team that replies faster and better, with you steering it

- Angry customers leaving happy, visible in reviews and repeat purchases

title: AI Operations Assistant | Work directly with founder | Base pay + growth to full time
description:
Hi, I'm Jakob. Here is a video where I introduce myself, show you what your work would actually look like, and explain the deal: 
/share/2c0e8487f1f640f1aab4fde3f5ab6d4d



WHAT THIS IS



I run an Irish company that builds AI-driven operations for growing businesses. Right now I'm embedded in a fast-growing US lead generation agency (grew to $120k/month in about two months) where I build the systems, automations, and tracking that let it scale. I automate everything that can be automated. This role is my right hand for everything that still needs a sharp human.



You would be working directly with me as my right hand. And you would not be my first Filipino teammate: over the years I have worked with 20+ people from the Philippines through Upwork and OnlineJobs.ph, so I know how to make this work well for both sides. As the work grows, this role grows with it.



A bit about me: I started programming at 13, had my first client at 14, and left the standard education path to learn on my own. I was working as a developer at 17. Since then I have built systems and automations for 50+ companies, including founders from the Forbes 30 Under 30 list. If you want to understand how I think, I share my ideas here: 



WHAT YOU WILL DO



1. Data checks and cleanup in our systems (GoHighLevel, spreadsheets, dashboards)

2. Verifying records: appointments, links, statuses. Catching what looks wrong

3. Making sure the IT systems match our flowcharts, and that people are informed about system changes and how to use them

4. Using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) as part of daily work. I will teach you my workflows, and I expect you to get good at them

5. Coordinating a few personal logistics (for example scheduling with my chef)

6. Over time: owning entire recurring processes end to end



HOW WE WORK TOGETHER



The work has two modes.



BUILD MODE: when we are diving into a system and building it out, we work LIVE on a Zoom call. Both on, screen sharing, I figure out what needs to happen, you take each task the 
nt it is clear and do it while I keep working on the next thing, and we review and adjust on the spot. Think of it like mob programming: no briefs sitting in a queue for two days, no handover delays, the system gets built fast and you learn extremely quickly because you see the whole thinking process. I have worked this way with people from the Philippines before, sometimes long days on the same call, and it is intense and energizing. If that sounds draining to you, this is not your role. If it sounds fun, keep reading.



RUN MODE: once a system is built and figured out, the work becomes calmer. You get checklists and short screen recordings (Loom) as instructions, you work through them on your own time within our overlap hours, and you send back your results. Over time you graduate to owning these processes fully.



Most weeks are a mix of both. You get real responsibility fast if you show you can carry it.



THE DEAL



1. Part time to start: 20 hours per week GUARANTEED. You are paid the full base even in a lighter week: $
/month base, depending on experience

2. Hours beyond 20 are paid per hour: $5-7/hour

3. Busy weeks can reach 40+ hours. I need someone who WANTS those hours

4. 13th month pay

5. First raise review after 90 days, tied to the processes you own, not time served

6. Working hours: I'm in Europe, so overlap with my day means your AFTERNOON and EVENING (around 15:00-24:00 Philippine time). I need at least 3 hours of overlap. Your mornings stay yours, and the normal working hours are nothing like the graveyard shifts of a US client



Side projects and other gigs are fine. I would honestly rather hire someone who builds things. The deal is simple: your base hours are sacred, and when I need extra hours on short notice (24 to 48 hours), this role comes first. If you can commit to that, everything else is your time.



WHO YOU ARE



1. You have used ChatGPT or Claude for actual work, or you badly want to make AI tools your daily toolkit

2. Detail-oriented: you follow instructions exactly and flag anything that looks off instead of guessing

3. You enjoy working live on a call: screen sharing, getting feedback, adjusting in real time

4. Strong written and spoken English (we talk a lot on calls)

5. Reliable internet and your own computer, good enough for long Zoom calls with screen share

6. Available now, with room to grow your hours

7. Hungry. You want to learn how modern businesses are actually built



HOW THE HIRING WORKS



1. You apply (see below). I review every application that follows the instructions within 48 hours

2. Shortlisted candidates get a short video call with me

3. Then a PAID live working session: you join me on Zoom, we work on real tasks together, real pay. Both of us see if it fits

4. If it fits, we start properly



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word anchor so I know you read this far.

Then answer these three questions (short and honest beats long and polished):



1. What other work or commitments do you have right now, and what is the maximum weekly hours you could reliably give me?

2. Describe one real thing you have done with AI tools (or built on your own initiative). What was it, and what did you actually do?

3. Why this role instead of a generic VA job?



Bonus (not required): include a link to a 1 minute video introducing yourself, just like I did for you.

title: Real Estate Media Virtual Assistant (Photo QC + Media Delivery) | Photoshop / Lightroom
description:
Job Description



We are looking for a detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to help with quality control and delivery of real estate media.



This role is primarily responsible for reviewing real estate photos and videos before they are delivered to clients to ensure everything looks correct, complete, and professional.



You will review large batches of photos quickly and accurately, catching editing issues before delivery.

A typical shift may involve reviewing 100–200+ photos, so speed, focus, and attention to detail are extremely important.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys structured work, visual detail, and organized systems.

Compensation: $4–$8 USD/hour

Hours: 10–20 hours per week

Preferred schedule: Morning EST or CST



Your Main Responsibility (Quality Control)



This is the most important part of the role.



You will:

• Review 100+ real estate photos per shift

• Check for editing issues such as:

exposure problems

color balance issues

crooked vertical lines

cropping mistakes



HDR blending errors



object removal mistakes (trash cans, cords, etc.)

• Ensure photo order and folder structure are correct

• Confirm files are ready for delivery to clients

• Flag issues to the editing team when something needs fixing



You must be able to move through large batches of photos efficiently without missing mistakes.



Additional Responsibilities

File Organization

• Maintain organized Google Drive folders

• Upload and deliver final media



Instagram Outreach

• Send outreach messages to potential clients

• Track conversations and follow-ups



QC and media delivery are the core responsibilities, outreach is secondary.

Required Skills

Candidates must have real photo editing experience, specifically:

• Adobe Lightroom

• Adobe Photoshop



Important:

Canva experience does NOT count as Photoshop experience for this role.

You do not need to be a full editor, but you must be able to recognize when an image looks incorrect.

You should understand:



• exposure issues

• color balance

• vertical line correction

• cropping problems

• HDR blending issues



Major Bonus Experience

Experience with real estate media workflows is a major advantage.



Examples include:

• HDPhotoHub

• Spiro

• AutoHDR

• Real estate media delivery platforms

• HDR editing workflows



Candidates with these skills usually ramp up much faster.



Ideal Candidate Background



The best candidates often come from:

• Photo editors

• Real estate media virtual assistants

• Real estate marketing assistants

• Photo retouchers

• Post-production assistants



Traits We Look For



You are likely a great fit if you are:

• Extremely detail oriented

• Comfortable reviewing large batches of images quickly

• Organized and process-driven

• Able to work independently after training

• Reliable and consistent with your schedule

• Comfortable communicating when issues arise



Non-Negotiables

• Availability: 10–20 hours per week

• Morning availability (EST/CST preferred)

• Reliable internet connection (large files involved)

• Clear written English

• Photoshop and Lightroom familiarity

• Ownership mindset



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



A brief introduction about your experience with Photoshop and Lightroom



Your internet speed



Links to any photo editing work or portfolio



Your availability (days and hours)



To confirm you read this entire job post, please include the phrase:

“I care about details.”

at the top of your application.

Applications that do not include this phrase will not be considered.

title: Experienced DM Appointment Setter for Established Online Coaching Business
description:
Are you a proven appointment setter who turns warm conversations into booked calls? Read on.



I'm a UK-based Career Coach running a growing online coaching community and programme. I have an established, engaged audience of thousands of followers that are ready to be outreached to.



This is not a cold outreach role. The audience already exists. Your job is to start and manage natural conversations with warm leads, qualify them, and move the right people into booked calls for our coaching programmes.



The role:



You'll be setting appointments through DMs (primarily LinkedIn), having genuine, natural-sounding conversations with people who already know my content. You'll qualify leads against clear criteria, book qualified prospects into my calendar, and keep every conversation tracked and followed up. Nobody falls through the cracks on your watch. Attention to detail is important as it's vital you follow through on every lead and never leave anyone without following through.



Your daily responsibilities:



- Send a daily report detailing conversations started, follow-ups sent, leads qualified, and appointments booked

- Manage DM conversations with warm leads: info-gather, build rapport, qualify against our criteria, and book qualified prospects into the calendar

- Follow up consistently with every open conversation using a structured follow-up system (you'll help build and refine this)

- Track all conversations, pipeline stages, and outcomes in our tracking sheet or CRM

- Create and continually refine SOPs for the setting process based on what you see working against our KPIs and OKRs



To qualify for this position, you will need proven experience in the following:



- Appointment setting in the DMs for an online coach, course creator, or agency (this is essential, you must have done this exact role before)

- Lead qualification: knowing how to spot a right-fit prospect and how to gracefully filter out the rest

- Excellent written English: your messages must sound natural, warm, and human, never scripted or robotic



What will really help you stand out:



- You come with your own ideas. You've seen what works in DM setting and you proactively suggest improvements

- You've worked to KPIs and OKRs before and can talk specifically about the numbers you hit

- Experience with CRM or pipeline tracking tools

- Familiarity with LinkedIn as a platform



We're building something long-term, so it's really important that you are:



- Detail-obsessed: you remember what people told you three conversations ago

- Consistent: you show up every single day and do the work without needing to be chased

- Resilient: you don't give up after one reply goes quiet, you follow up

- Observant with a great memory: you pick up on the small things people share and use them to build genuine rapport

- Positive, dedicated, and loyal

- Coachable: you take direction well, you're open to feedback, and you're always learning



Work schedule:



This is a part-time position to start, with the goal of hiring full-time for the right candidate.

UK/US timezone overlap is helpful but not required for all tasks.



Salary:



$400/month for part-time work (20 hours a week), with salary reviewed when the role moves to full-time. This is a base salary role only.



This role has genuine room to grow to full-time depending on your capability. You'll be working directly with me, the founder, and as the business grows, this role can grow with it.



How to apply:



When applying, put "I set the standard" in the subject heading.



In your application, please answer these questions:



1. Describe your previous appointment setting experience: who did you set for, what was the offer, and what were your numbers (conversations per day, booking rate, show rate)?

2. A warm lead has been chatting with you in the DMs about their career frustrations. Write the exact messages you would send to find out, in a soft and natural way, whether they earn above a specific income threshold, without it sounding blunt, harsh, or transactional

3. Describe your follow-up process when a lead goes quiet after showing initial interest

4. What is one improvement you made to a setting process in a previous role, and what result did it drive?



I look forward to hearing from you.

title: Vibe Coder (Full-Time) - AI Video Automation Platform
description:
READ EVERYTHING BEFORE APPLYING - SEND THE REQUIREMENTS.



Company Overview



We operate a growing network of YouTube channels across multiple niches and languages. We are now looking to build a fully automated AI video production platform from scratch.



The goal is to create an internal app that can generate complete long-form YouTube videos automatically — from script generation and voiceover to AI avatar footage, matching b-roll, subtitles, thumbnails, metadata, and Google Drive delivery.



We are looking for a Vibe Coder / AI Engineer / Prompt Engineer who can build this app fast using AI coding tools like Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT, Manus, Copilot, and similar tools.



This is not a traditional software engineering role. We need someone who can move extremely fast, build with AI, connect APIs, debug issues, and ship a working product quickly.



Initial Project



The first project is to build the complete AI video automation app from scratch.



Budget for the first MVP/app: $500 USD



This includes the full app, the main workflow, and the different interfaces needed to operate the system.



The app must be created within approximately 2 weeks, so we are looking for someone who can work full-time, focus fully on this project, and make fast progress every day.



After the first version is completed, we want to keep the right person on the team full-time to continue improving the platform, adding new workflows, building new features, fixing bugs, optimizing costs, and maintaining the system long-term.



Target Video Style & Quality



We are building toward a very specific output style and quality level.



The platform must be able to automatically create videos similar to the channels below. Before applying, you must watch several videos from these channels and understand the format, pacing, structure, visuals, and overall quality we are trying to replicate:















These channels are the output format and quality we are building toward.



The system should be able to:



Generate the full script

Generate the voiceover

Generate AI avatar footage of the character speaking the script

Pull matching stock b-roll for each scene

Create split-screen segments when needed

Assemble the complete edited video automatically

Generate subtitles

Generate thumbnails

Generate titles and descriptions

Export the final video to Google Drive



The goal is that no human editor is needed for the final production process.



Most videos will usually be around 20–30 minutes long, so the system must be able to handle long-form content, not just short clips.



We are not looking for a basic AI video generator. We want to build a real internal production platform that can create complete long-form YouTube videos in the same style, structure, and quality as the reference channels above.



Main Goal



The most important goal is to create a system that can produce complete videos at a very low cost.



Our target is around $1–$2 per video in total AI/API cost.



We know this is possible because other people already have systems working at this cost level. We are looking for someone with experience, speed, and the ability to build the same kind of system for us.



What You Will Build



You will build an internal web app that manages the full AI video production workflow.



The app should include different interfaces such as:



Project dashboard

Video generation dashboard

Script generation interface

Voiceover generation interface

AI avatar generation workflow

B-roll matching workflow

Video assembly workflow

Thumbnail generation interface

Export / Google Drive delivery interface

Cost tracking dashboard

Status tracking for each video

Multi-channel and multi-language management



The first version does not need to be perfect, but it must work.



We need a functional MVP that can generate complete videos, be tested, improved, and scaled.



Technical Responsibilities



You will be responsible for choosing the best technical structure and tools to build the app quickly.



You may work with tools such as:



React

TypeScript

Next.js

Node.js

Python

Tailwind

Supabase

Firebase

tRPC

APIs

Google Drive API

YouTube API

TTS APIs

AI image/video generation APIs

AI avatar APIs

Stock footage APIs

Automation tools

Cursor

Claude

ChatGPT

Manus

Copilot



You do not need to know every single tool already, but you must be able to learn quickly, use AI coding assistants effectively, and solve problems independently.



AI Workflow & API Integrations



A major part of this role will be connecting different AI tools and services together through APIs.



This may include:



Text generation APIs

Voiceover / TTS APIs

AI avatar generation APIs

Image generation APIs

Video generation APIs

Stock footage APIs

Subtitle APIs

Google Drive API

YouTube Data API

Internal prompt systems

Cost tracking systems

Workflow automation



We want someone who understands how to build a complete workflow where different AI tools work together automatically.



Cost Optimization



Cost optimization is extremely important.



The system must be designed to generate videos for around $1–$2 per video if possible.



We are not looking for someone who simply connects expensive tools manually. We need someone who can test different providers, compare API costs, optimize prompts, reduce waste, and create an efficient production workflow.



Speed and cost efficiency matter a lot.



What We Are Looking For



You must be highly proficient with AI coding tools.



You should be able to take an idea, break it down, prompt AI tools to generate code, review the code, fix bugs, connect APIs, and ship working features fast.



You should be comfortable working with codebases even if AI writes a large part of the code. You still need to understand what the code does, how to debug it, and how to make it work in production.



You must be able to build from scratch. This is important. We do not already have the platform built. Your job is to help us create it from zero.



You must be proactive. We will explain the goal, but we will not write every detail for you. You need to think, suggest solutions, test tools, compare APIs, and build the best workflow possible.



You must be very fast. We are looking for someone who can build an MVP in around 2 weeks, not months.



You must be reliable and responsive. This is a full-time project and we need someone who can communicate clearly, give daily updates, and solve problems without disappearing.



Required Experience



Experience building apps, web platforms, dashboards, automations, or internal tools

Experience using AI coding tools such as Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, Manus, or similar

Experience working with APIs

Experience with React, TypeScript, Node.js, Next.js, Python, or similar stacks

Understanding of AI video generation workflows

Understanding of AI voiceover, AI avatars, image generation, prompt engineering, and automation

Ability to build fast and improve through iteration

Ability to work full-time and focus deeply on this project



Nice to Have



Experience building AI video automation systems

Experience with YouTube automation

Experience with YouTube Data API or YouTube Analytics API

Experience with Google Drive API

Experience with TTS APIs

Experience with AI avatar tools

Experience with stock footage APIs

Experience with image/video generation APIs

Experience with Supabase, Firebase, tRPC, Drizzle, or similar tools

Experience building admin dashboards

Experience optimizing API costs

Experience creating systems that generate videos for $1–$2 per video



Working Style



We need someone who can work full-time and focus fully on this project.



During the first 2 weeks, this project should be your main priority. We need daily progress, fast communication, and someone who is actively building every day.



This is not a small side task. We are looking for someone who can take ownership of the app and build the first version quickly.



After the MVP is completed, we want to continue working with the right person full-time to improve workflows, add features, maintain the system, and scale the platform.



Compensation



Initial MVP / Full App Build: $500 USD



This payment is for building the first working version of the app, including the main video automation workflow and the different interfaces needed to operate the system.



After the MVP is completed successfully, we can discuss a full-time monthly role to continue improving and maintaining the platform.



Payment Method: Wise or Binance



What We Provide



We will pay for the required software subscriptions, AI coding tools, API credits, and SaaS tools needed for the role.



This can include Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT, Manus, API credits, hosting, database tools, and other software required to build the platform.



You are responsible for your own computer, internet connection, and work setup.
